source: Black Sword Hack - Ultimate Chaos Edition SRD v1.0.2, Experience: Gifts.
completeness_note: All 15 Gifts are recorded, 5 per category, transcribed from the SRD on August 4, 2026. Feature lines paraphrase the SRD into one operational line each for tool use, matching the convention rules/attribution.md records for backgrounds; the SRD holds the authoritative wording. Each Gift's automation field records whether the effect registry (rules/effects.json) drives it ('effect') or the narrator applies its text as a ruling ('manual'); read the field per entry rather than assuming a count, since a mechanization slice flips one entry at a time. Spirit alliance, Dark revelation, and Dubious friendships are automated as of August 25, 2026: each grants Advantage on a specific subsystem roll (the declared spirit's own invocation, the Torn Veil table, the Demon's Revenge table) through the same effects.json hooks the other Advantage-granting Gifts use.

structure.rule: Each Gift can be taken only once.

gifts.name: Fortress of the mind
gifts.feature: Advantage on attribute tests that resist spells.

gifts.name: Meditation
gifts.feature: Restore the Doom die after a short rest.

gifts.name: Second wind
gifts.feature: Regain hit points equal to the character's level once per day, even in combat.

gifts.name: Spirit alliance
gifts.feature: Advantage when summoning one specific spirit.

gifts.name: Survivor's luck
gifts.feature: Once per session, ignore all damage from one attack and lose a weapon doing it.

gifts.name: Armour of scars
gifts.feature: Reduce damage received by 1 while wearing no armour.

gifts.name: Bloodlust
gifts.feature: Upgrade the damage die one step.

gifts.name: Dark revelation
gifts.feature: Roll Torn Veil tests with Advantage.

gifts.name: Dubious friendships
gifts.feature: Roll Demon's revenge tests with Advantage.

gifts.name: Battle hardened
gifts.feature: In combat, an unmodified roll of 1 to 3 is a critical success.

gifts.name: Resourceful
gifts.feature: Replenish one Usage die other than Doom once per session without resting.

gifts.name: Riddle of steel
gifts.feature: One weapon deals d12 damage and breaks on a damage roll of 1.

gifts.name: Tough as nails
gifts.feature: After surviving the Helpless table, add the character's level to the hit points regained.

gifts.name: Will to live
gifts.feature: Advantage on rolls against the Helpless table.
